monitoringNote: Inspect tender flush, buds, and new leaves.
Inspect leaf undersides, young shoots, fruit, and branches.
Inspect fresh flush for live serpentine mines.
Inspect the underside of new leaves.
Inspect lower leaf surfaces and honeydew/sooty mould.
Inspect both leaf surfaces; reliable identification may need magnification.
Inspect fruit, fallen fruit, and documented traps.
Inspect root collar, trunk base, basin, and canopy.
Inspect leaves, twigs, and fruit for raised rough lesions.
Record whether yellowing starts on new or old leaves; check orchard distribution and root-zone conditions before naming a deficiency.
Record weed species, crop age, and whether weeds are competing in the basin or only between rows.
